context: Returning from a Hong Kong trip
purpose: Recount the trip; teach 香港/直前/殆ど/欧米/アフリカ/神戸/広島/わが国

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: How was the Hong Kong trip?
lines.style: curious friend welcoming him back, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 出発の直前まで仕事だったから、疲れたよ。
lines.en: I worked right up to departure, so I’m tired.
lines.style: weary friend admitting, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でも殆どの観光地は回れたんでしょ？
lines.en: But you covered almost all the sights, right?
lines.style: friend confirming, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、現地の食文化は欧米とは全然違う。
lines.en: Yeah — the food culture is totally unlike Europe/America.
lines.style: friend reflecting, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 次はアフリカも視野に入れてる？
lines.en: Are you considering Africa next too?
lines.style: friend exploring further, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いつかね。国内では神戸と広島が候補。
lines.en: Someday. Domestically, Kobe and Hiroshima are candidates.
lines.style: friend planning, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わが国の歴史も、もっと知りたいね。
lines.en: I want to know our country’s history more too.
lines.style: wistful friend closing, each word carrying genuine natural feeling
